lolCoach.title: Decatron Coach · LoL
lolCoach.subtitle: Comments on champion select, gives you runes/spells/build when you lock in and an opinion when the game ends. Stays quiet in game (Riot rules).
lolCoach.saved: Saved. The app picks it up on its own.

req.clientHint: Open League of Legends with the app running

lolCoach.aiUnavailable: AI is not configured on the server (OpenRouter). Tell the admin.
lolCoach.enabledHint: Starts commenting on the next champion select.
lolCoach.coachNameHint: How it introduces itself on the overlay and in chat (!coach). Pick any: Jarvis, Sensei, Coach…

troll.label: Troll
troll.desc: Sarcastic, teases you with love. Never toxic to others.

lolCoach.briefingHint: Once a day: rank and LP, how yesterday went, your best champion of the week, streak and today's goal.
lolCoach.lobbyHint: When someone joins: your record playing with that person, their public rank, their form over the last 20 games and their top champions. Shown on the overlay (status line) and here.
lolCoach.tiltHint: After 3 losses in a row this session it asks whether you keep going or stop. Off by default: many find it annoying.
lolCoach.dailyGoalHint: "Reach Gold I", "3 wins", "don't die before 10". Lasts up to 18 h; also via !meta in chat. The coach brings it up in the briefing and after each game.
lolCoach.commentPicks: Comment on every pick and ban
lolCoach.commentPicksHint: Up to 8 comments per select. If off, it only speaks on your turn and at the end (2 calls).
lolCoach.postGame: Automatic opinion when the game ends
lolCoach.showOnOverlay: Show what it says on the overlay
lolCoach.showOnOverlayHint: "Coach says" widget in Game Overlays → Design. If off, only you see it in the app and via commands.
lolCoach.champPoolHint: Comma-separated. If empty, it uses your most played champions from the last 20 games.
lolCoach.notesHint: Go into the prompt as-is: "I hate playing tanks", "I'm support but get autofilled mid", "don't recommend Yasuo".
lolCoach.predictionsHint: When each game starts the bot opens a prediction: win or lose? Viewers bet the channel's prediction points (free, not DecaCoins) and those who get it right split the pot. Resolves on its own with the real result and shows on the overlay ("Chat prediction" widget). Doesn't need the AI coach.
lolCoach.voiceHint: Speaks through your speakers or headphones (you choose the device in the app). Uses the channel's TTS credits, like Speak Chat.

live.title: Right now
live.noClient: No LoL client. When you open the game with Decatron Desktop, the phase and picks show here in real time.
live.silent: the coach stays quiet until it ends.
live.capReached: Your plan's daily cap is reached; the coach speaks again tomorrow.

history.title: Latest from the coach
history.empty: Nothing yet. Every comment shows here, with runes/build/tips when given.

gameOverlays.title: Game Overlays
gameOverlays.subtitle: Rank, session and matches on screen, for the game you're playing
gameOverlays.confirmDelete: Delete overlay "{{slug}}"? Its URL will stop working in OBS.
gameOverlays.confirmSwitch: You have unsaved changes. Switch overlay anyway?

first.title: Create your first overlay
first.hint: One instance = one URL for OBS. One is enough; higher plans allow several (e.g. a compact one and a big one for the starting-soon screen).

url.title: URL for OBS
url.hint: Add a browser source with this URL and the canvas size ({{size}}). One source for every game.
url.name: Name

accounts.linkHint: Accounts are yours (the person's), not the channel's: they work for Twitch and Kick. Your plan allows {{count}} per game.
accounts.noApi: {{game}} has no API connected yet: set the rank by hand on the account (below) or in chat with
accounts.atLimit_one: You reached the limit of {{count}} account for {{game}}.
accounts.atLimit_other: You reached the limit of {{count}} accounts for {{game}}.
accounts.verifyHint1: To verify it's your account: in the League client, change your
accounts.verifyHint3: (the first ones in the list, free), save, and press verify.

games.title: Games
games.hint: Enable the games you stream. The overlay shows only the one you're playing (by stream category) and hides for the rest.
games.noAccounts: You have no {{game}} accounts. Link one in the Accounts tab.
games.rotationOrder: Rotation order is the order you checked them in.
games.queueHint: Applies to all accounts; each account can override it on the right.

detection.forcedMsg: Showing {{game}} until you go back to automatic
detection.statusHint: The category arrives in real time from Twitch/Kick. If you switch games without changing the category, the overlay won't know: use the override below or the command
detection.idleMultiCard: Card with all my ranks (coming soon)
detection.forceHint: Overrides detection until you go back to automatic. Same as in chat:

design.title: Design
design.hint: What you see here is exactly what shows in OBS. Sample data.
design.confirmReset: Reset this game to the default design?
design.desktopSimHint: Simulates what Decatron Desktop sends when the LoL client is open
design.presetHint: Turns elements on and off; doesn't touch fonts or colors

elementHelp.streak: Only shows from 2 wins or losses in a row (session if any, otherwise the last 20).
elementHelp.topChamps: Most played champions in the last 20 games of the chosen queue, with winrate and KDA.
elementHelp.mastery: Account's top mastery (level and points). Updates hourly.
elementHelp.lpGraph: Today's session LP curve. Only shows live and with at least two LP changes.
elementHelp.champSelect: Your team's picks (yours highlighted), the enemy's and bans, in real time during select. Needs Decatron Desktop open with the LoL client. Use "Desktop: Select" above to see it.
elementHelp.postGame: Result, KDA, CS, damage and ±LP when the game ends, until you're back in the lobby. Needs Decatron Desktop. Use "Desktop: Game over" above to see it.
elementHelp.prediction: Live pot of the chat prediction (!pred win|loss): how much on each side, how many bet and when it closes; at the end, the winning side and who got it right. Enable it in Features → Decatron Coach → Predictions. Use "Desktop: In game" or "Game over" to see it.
elementHelp.coachSay: The coach's latest comment (Features → Decatron Coach). Shows in champion select and at the end; hidden in game. Use "Desktop: Select" or "Game over" to see it.
elementHelp.liveCharacter: Without Desktop: "In game · champion" from the Riot API (1-3 min delay). With Desktop: lobby, searching, select, in game with a timer and result, instantly.
elementHelp.gameLogo: Shows the game name in the accent color, above the rank.

design.slidesHint: The card cycles through views on its own, like a GIF: main → stats → champions → LP graph. Only views with data are shown.
design.slidesOnlyStats: Available for games with stats (League of Legends for now).
design.promoHint: Every so often, the account card is covered for a few seconds by the Decatron logo and a message so your viewers get to know the bot.
design.promoForced: On the free plan it always shows: it's what keeps Decatron free. It can be hidden from the Supporter plan up.
design.promoNote: Uses the card's background and accent. Press "Decatron card" above the canvas to see it.
